name: SIQ - Collection Tabs Scroll
description: Multi-phase scroll-driven section with glassmorphism collection tabs. Starts with centered heading, description and glass-effect tab bar showing collection icons. On scroll: text slides up, tabs move to top, hero image grows and shifts right, collection info text appears left, a CTA button fades onto the image, and finally the single image splits into a product grid. Each tab switches the active collection. Premium scroll storytelling for editorial collections.
author: SectionIQ
